title: Reactive layering in WebFlux + JPA application
body_excerpt: Given: A blocking Spring Data repository. A service layer wrapping the said repository. [code] , performs both read and write operations. And a WebFlux handler invoked by a [code] . which layer should start wrapping data objects in Reactor publishers? Option 1. The service layer simply delegates to the repository, mapping data objects with an injected mapper. It's the handler class that wraps them in publishers. [CODE] [CODE] Option 2. The service layer performs the wrapping, the handler mostly maps results to [code] objects. My take: push it into the service.
